concurrency.method: Elastic offered-load search; short high-to-low screens followed by a sustained confirmation run. A rate passes when success rate >= 99.9%, P90 latency <= 1.2x paired low-rate baseline, latency trend is stable, and the pool drains.

resource_measurement.unavailable_reason: The sampler could not include the native Qwen engine child process; the observed server-only CPU/RSS values understate inference resource use.

0.45.reason: Four HTTP 503 inference_overloaded responses; SmartVoice inference queue reached capacity.

concurrency.interpretation: Highest confirmed passing offered rate observed was 0.321 req/s. This is a tested operating point, not a finely established maximum: higher-rate results were inconsistent across baseline runs and include latency failures and queue-overload errors. The runtime uses one native engine process and serializes synthesis, so increasing HTTP concurrency does not create parallel native inference.
limitations: Paired baseline P90 varied materially across runs; the 0.321 confirmation baseline was 3.878 seconds, while earlier baseline observations were faster. Interpret the boundary conservatively.
Native engine child process was not included in process-tree sampling; CPU/RSS and delivered requests per CPU core are omitted.
The report represents Chinese short-text concurrency on this macOS arm64 host; it does not establish multilingual or other-hardware capacity.

interpretation: Observed comparison results only; not an acceptance threshold or cross-platform ranking.
